01

Smarter Optimization, Built In

Carter now works behind the scenes to keep your campaigns performing — spotting issues and acting on them so you don't have to. Instead of digging through dashboards to figure out what's slipping, you get the important signals surfaced for you, the moment they matter. It's like having an analyst watching every channel around the clock, so your time goes to strategy instead of monitoring.

  • Always-on benchmarking. Carter continuously measures performance across every connected channel and flags underperformance the moment it happens.
  • Clear, ranked fixes. It identifies what's driving a dip and recommends the highest-impact fixes, each with an expected impact and risk level.
  • Optimization on your terms. Review recommendations yourself, approve changes before they go live, or let Carter optimize automatically within the limits you set.
  • Smarter budget allocation. Shift spend toward your best-performing channels and ad items — with a clear record of every change.

Recommendations grouped by priority, each with an expected impact and risk level.

02

Carter Now Supports Native Ads

Reach audiences with native advertising everywhere you run — built to launch fast and stay consistent. Native ads blend into the content people are already engaging with, helping your message feel less like an interruption and more like part of the experience.

  • Native across every channel. Run native ads, including carousel formats, across all your connected channels.
  • Built-in lead capture. Collect prospect information directly within the ad using lead-gen forms.
  • Launch faster with templates. Reusable templates keep your creative consistent and make new formats easy to roll out.

Create a native ad template — select channels, placements, and ad type in one setup.

03

Target the Right People on Every Channel

Reaching your best audiences just got easier — so you can spend where it counts and connect with the people most likely to convert. Whether you start from your own customer data or simply describe who you're after, Carter does the heavy lifting of matching that audience to each channel.

  • Your customer data, activated everywhere. Use your own customer segments across all your connected channels, no manual rebuilding required.
  • Describe your ideal customer. Tell Carter who you want to reach in plain language, and it builds a matching audience tuned to each channel automatically.
  • Know your reach before you launch. See instantly where your audience is a strong match across channels, so there are no surprises.

Describe your ideal customer — Carter matches cohorts to every connected channel.

04

Full Control Over Spend and Costs

Managing your offsite budgets just got simpler and more transparent — clear control over every dollar, from funding to final cost. Every fee and cost is laid out plainly, so you always know exactly where your money is going and what you're paying for.

  • Set your ceiling, spend with confidence. Fund a wallet and Carter keeps every campaign within it, so you never overspend.
  • See exactly what you pay. Ad spend, platform fees, and media fees are broken out clearly across every campaign and ad item.
  • Pricing that rewards scale. Volume-based fee tiers mean rates improve as spend grows, whether you run on your own seat or Carter's.
  • Configure fees your way. Admins can set tiered fees per channel, preview the impact before saving, and trust that every change is logged.

Set media and platform fees per channel, calculated as a percentage of ad delivery cost.

05

Introducing Bid Multipliers

A powerful new way to control your bidding. Carter now lets you set bid multipliers on your keywords and categories — so you can put more weight behind what matters most and shape how your budget is spent, beyond the base bid.

  • Keywords and categories. Apply multipliers at both the keyword and category level.
  • Ad items and creatives. Set them on ad items and creatives alike, for control wherever you need it.
  • More precise spend. Direct budget toward your highest-value targeting, on your terms.

The Bid Multiplier column in the Keywords Listing.
